scope: Device-free original analytic PCM and finite authored geometry only

history.earlierProfile: Before V8 sampling was added; retained unchanged.16 children,144 blocks each,18.9385-28.5935ms maxima,one overrun per child.
history.invocationFailure: Initial PowerShell redirection failed before Node started because the fresh checkout had no .local directory. No test/profile measurements were produced in that attempt. Codex retained a failure note and created the directory before fresh runs.

interpretation.historical: Fresh local authored workloads cannot reconstruct or assign a cause to the hosted 42.9559 ms maximum or historical 30-80 ms maxima. No OS scheduler trace was captured.
interpretation.nesting: Compare exclusive sibling costs; inclusive control/update/renderer spans are nested and must not be summed. GC temporal overlap is an independent annotation, not an additive cost.
interpretation.reference: Fresh process reference/instrumented pairs validate every dry/stereo PCM block, cursor, frame count and renderer history. Timing differences are observational; instrumentation and child order affect them.
interpretation.sourcePins: Selected source hashes identify measured implementations, not a complete dependency closure.

limits.cpu: Thread CPU readings were visibly coarse, frequently0 for short phases; max blocks reported15/16/31/32ms. Negative wall-minus-CPU and signed residuals remain visible. No phase0 means zero work.
limits.samples: Requested500us V8 stack sampling supplies raw node/sample/timeDelta evidence and clock-bracketed membership. Counts are not CPU durations; uncertainty leaves most short phases unattributed.
limits.gc: Main-isolate temporal overlaps only; neither additive cost nor causal explanation.
limits.scheduler: Callback probes/event-loop histogram measure dispatch effects. No independent OS scheduler trace; OS descheduling remains unqualified.
